set.body:
package object hrf re-exports scalafim.fmri.hrf.linalg.{Mat, Vec}. That is what leaks both types into every file doing import scalafim.fmri.hrf.*, and it is the source of the ambiguity surface wherever a file also imports gale types.

Deliberately left alone during the hrf hardening pass, recorded here so the decision is not lost rather than because it is urgent.

Why it was declined: removing the export requires adding explicit imports across roughly 12 files in design/model/fit/group for no behavioural gain, and hrf.linalg.Mat is staying as the boundary type for now. Mat is genuinely load-bearing: ~60 files, 65 Mat.unsafe call sites, a public row-major .data field read directly, and it is re-exposed in the public APIs of design (EventModel.designMatrix), model (FmriModel.designMatrix, DesignBlock.matrix), fit and group.

Two things that would make this worth revisiting:
- a decision to move hrf onto gale.linalg or scalafim.linalg, which is the larger change this is really a proxy for
- splitting SamplingFrame + Seconds into a small timing module, which would delete the dataset -> hrf edge entirely since dataset/dataset-zarr/fit/interop import nothing else from hrf

Context: docs/plans/hrf-hardening.md sections 2 and 7.
set.title: Decide the fate of the Vec/Mat re-export from package object hrf
